kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تستشهدوا (form X)
# تَسْتَشْهِدُوا (tastašhidū) /tas.taʃ.hi.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada)
# تُسْتَشْهَدُوا (tustašhadū) /tus.taʃ.ha.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada) and اُسْتُشْهِدَ (ustušhida)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
